title: Batch payment processor timeout under high concurrency
body: When processing more than 500 concurrent payment requests, the batch processor times out after 30 seconds. This appears to be a connection pool exhaustion issue in the payment gateway adapter.

title: API Gateway latency spikes during analytics payload aggregation
body: Response times on /v2/analytics/aggregate exceed 5000ms when handling requests with over 50 filter parameters. Cache miss rate is 42%.

title: Webhook delivery queue backpressure during database replication sync
body: Webhook events were delayed by up to 15 minutes during replica failovers. Resolved by increasing worker thread pool from 8 to 32.

title: SSO OAuth2 token refresh failing for Okta identity provider
body: Enterprise users using Okta SSO experience 401 Unauthorized errors after 8 hours due to expired refresh tokens not renewing automatically.

title: Data synchronization pipeline dropping events on schema migration
body: CRM sync connector drops contact updates when customer records contain nested JSON arrays exceeding 64KB.

title: Stripe webhook signature validation failing intermittently
body: Clock drift between edge servers caused Stripe webhook verification failures. Fixed by synchronizing NTP across all edge nodes.

title: Request to add Webhook HMAC signature verification in CI/CD pipeline
body: Customer requesting capability to verify inbound webhook signatures using SHA-256 HMAC tokens.

title: HubSpot CRM adapter rate limiting on bulk contact export
body: Bulk sync operations exceed HubSpot API rate limit of 100 requests per 10 seconds, causing exponential backoff retries to stall.

title: Memory leak in Node.js background worker process under sustained load
body: Unclosed Redis connection handles in background task runner caused heap memory to grow steadily until OOM crash.

title: GraphQL query complexity limit blocking custom reporting queries
body: Enterprise reporting queries fail with 'Query complexity exceeds maximum limit of 1000' when querying nested audit logs.
